preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a string consisting only of lowercase English letters.
The length of S and the value of k are within the specified constraints.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' if (k_corrected > len(S) or len(S) - k_corrected == 0) else (return_value != '-1' and len(return_value) == len(S) - k_corrected and return_value == ''.join(sorted(S, key=lambda x: x)[:len(S)-k_corrected]) if k_corrected == 0 else True)
postconditions.description: If the corrected k (k_corrected) is greater than the length of S or results in an empty string, return '-1'. Otherwise, return the lexicographically smallest string of length len(S) - k_corrected formed by removing exactly k_corrected characters from S.
The corrected value of k is k divided by 2 if the length of S is a power of 2, otherwise k multiplied by 2.
